# Read-only diagnostic. Instruments the WORLD trade-price layer that feeds gbip_silver -> the CHI
# currency peg -> the #23 period-2 currency oscillation. Two independent deep-traces proved CHI is a
# price-TAKER (produces zero silver); the oscillator lives in the producer-side trade zones, which the
# CHI-scoped CURX dump could not see. This probe reads the WORLD trade-zone globals (readable from any
# scope) so ONE boot pins WHERE and WHY the trade price oscillates.
#
# BANDS (cheap, full coverage): every zone x {price,stock,order,pct} for silver + a grain CONTROL.
# EXACT TICKS (bounded, cap 2000): silver's per-zone price/stock/order + global aggregates.
#
# Emitted PRE and POST of quarterly_global_trade_6 via ECON_LOG_curx_dump_pre/_post (CHI-only,
# -debug_mode-gated). Uses the proven tick tail ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit (se_ECON_LOG.txt:639).
# No $param$ in any log string (all labels literal — the proven constraint). All global reads
# existence-guarded (unset -> UNSET/ZERO flag, never an error).

			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 10000 }    debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND grain baltic pct 1000-10000" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 100000 }   debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND grain baltic pct 10000-100000" }
			else = { debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND grain baltic pct >=100000" }
			remove_variable = ECON_LOG_tzp_v
		}
		# grain east_europe price
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = global_var:global_east_europe_tradezone } }  debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND grain east_europe price UNSET" }
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tzp_v  value = global_var:global_east_europe_tradezone.var:local_price_grain }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v > -999999999 } }  debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND grain east_europe price EMPTY" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v <= 0 }       debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND grain east_europe price 0" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 0.01 }     debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND grain east_europe price 0-0.01" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 0.1 }      debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND grain east_europe price 0.01-0.1" }

			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 10000 }    debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND grain east_mediterranean order 1000-10000" }

# ==== EXACT TICKS: silver price inputs that feed gbip (bounded; shared tail caps at 8000) ====
ECON_LOG_tzprobe_exact = {
	# Scope: country (CHI). Exact scaled-integer tick-counts for the silver PRICE inputs to gbip.
	# SCALE chosen so realistic values land well under the shared tail's 8000 cap. Read: count
	# "IMP19C TZP unit" after a "TZP LABEL ..." and before the next LABEL, / SCALE.
	# NOTE [review HIGH-2]: world-scale SUM vars (global_stockpile_silver, per-zone stock/order) are NOT
	# exact-ticked — they would peg the 8000 cap every dump (multi-GB log, truncated=useless). Their
	# magnitude is captured by the BANDS. Only gbip (post-sqrt, small) + per-zone local_price are ticked.
	debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver GLOBAL gbip"
	if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_base_import_price_silver }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_base_import_price_silver } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 2000 }
	ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
	# --- per-zone silver price / stockpile / order (the local_price = order/stockpile x0.6 inputs) ---
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver india price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_india_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_india_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 100 }
		ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver east_north_america price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_east_north_america_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_east_north_america_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 100 }
		ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver west_north_america price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_west_north_america_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_west_north_america_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 100 }
		ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver caribbean price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_caribbean_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_caribbean_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 100 }
		ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver west_south_america price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_west_south_america_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_west_south_america_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 100 }
		ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver east_south_america price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_east_south_america_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_east_south_america_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 100 }
		ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver south_east_asia price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_south_east_asia_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_south_east_asia_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 100 }
		ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver indo_china price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_indo_china_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_indo_china_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 100 }
		ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver yellow_sea price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_yellow_sea_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_yellow_sea_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 100 }
		ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver southern_africa price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_southern_africa_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_southern_africa_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 100 }
		ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver west_africa price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_west_africa_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_west_africa_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 100 }
		ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver east_africa price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_east_africa_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_east_africa_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
